89289511.s: About Al Qatt Al Asiri Museum (Fatima Museum). Visit the museum where the art of Al Qatt Al Asiri comes alive. This unique museum is dedicated to the heritage and art of Asiri women, offering an immersive experience that reveals their distinctive style of decorating homes and daily life.
89289511.b:
About Al Qatt Al Asiri Museum (Fatima Museum)

Visit Al Qatt Al Asiri Museum, where the art of Al Qatt Al Asiri comes alive. This unique museum is dedicated to the heritage and art of Asiri women, offering an immersive experience that reveals their distinctive style of decorating homes and daily life.

From the moment you enter, aromatic plants at the entrance welcome you and take you into a world of geometric patterns and bright ornamentation. The walls are decorated with colorful Qatt lines that tell stories of cultural heritage and artistic expression, which UNESCO has recognized as intangible heritage. Visitors can join educational workshops to learn about this art and buy products decorated with unique Qatt patterns. As you tour, you will learn about the beautiful symbols in Qatt designs that reflect the values and traditions of the local community. See the remarkable skill of Asiri women in extracting natural colors from the surrounding environment and using them to decorate homes.

Documenting Meaning in Al Qatt Al Asiri Designs

The artistic ornaments at Fatima Museum for the heritage of Asiri women show the aesthetic depths and symbolic meanings that come from the memory of southern identity. The triangle represents the woman, and the square symbolizes the completion of a reading of the Holy Quran, a sign of the importance of the religious dimension for the local community, while the patterns of combs lined up side by side at equal lengths reveal the essence of human relationships based on the principle of equality.

Creativity Renewed from Nature

The creativity of Asiri women shows in drawing bright colors from the natural resources of the Asir region. The journey of the pioneers of Al Qatt Al Asiri begins with extracting green from clover, then black from charcoal and yellow from turmeric, and is completed by mixing each color with gum arabic, until it takes a lasting form and a bright color that endures on the walls of southern homes radiating with life.

83416523.s: About the Artisans Fortress (Qalat Al Hirafiyyin). With its old, popular Al-Ahsa heritage character, it is one of the most important landmarks of Al-Ahsa, following its joining of the UNESCO Creative Cities Network in the field of crafts and folk arts.
83416523.b:
About the Artisans Fortress (Qalat Al Hirafiyyin)

The Artisans Fortress, with its old, popular Al-Ahsa heritage character, is one of the most important landmarks of Al-Ahsa, an extension of its joining the UNESCO Creative Cities Network in the field of crafts and folk arts.

Artistically, the Artisans Fortress is notable for its striking design drawn from Al-Ahsa architecture. It stands on an area of more than 12,000 square meters and consists of shops for self-driven crafts, while other shops are set aside for crafts that use water. All the shops are linked by covered passageways with windows that let in natural light and ventilate the market. At the center of the fortress is an open courtyard with a traditional coffee house and a traditional tannour bakery, as well as an events plaza from which folk events and festivals are launched.

The Artisans Fortress gives visitors a unique shopping experience through its amazing heritage shops, which bring together under one roof the pleasure of buying wonderful heritage products made by the hands of the city's most skilled artisans.

76339838.b:
Maraya rises from the sand like a mirage, its structure covered in reflective panels that show the beauty of AlUla and blend with the landscape among the desert valleys. This artistic masterpiece boasts 9,740 square meters of mirrors, making it the largest mirrored building in the world according to Guinness World Records.

Maraya celebrates the important historical role of AlUla as a meeting point of ancient civilizations over the centuries, and the reflective mirrors on the building form a contemporary artwork showing the area's long heritage. Maraya embraces AlUla's flourishing cultural and arts scene and hosts many distinctive artistic and entertainment events, establishing AlUla as a cultural center of world standing.

Maraya has hosted many concerts by leading stars of the Arab world such as Mohammed Abdu, Angham, Majid Al Muhandis, Kadim Al Sahir and Assala Nasri, as well as world celebrities such as Alicia Keys, John Legend, OneRepublic, Usher and Sade. It has also hosted art and creative exhibitions, such as the exhibition "Fame: Andy Warhol in AlUla" and the exhibition "What Remains in the Depths".

The World Tourism Organization awards ceremony is among the most important events held at Maraya, where AlUla Old Town won the title of Best Tourism Village along with 32 other villages from around the world.

Maraya welcomes different occasions, from business meetings and conferences to weddings and performances, and British Michelin-starred chef Jason Atherton welcomes guests to his fine-dining restaurant, Maraya Social, on the roof of the building.
